title: Itineraries
notes: Lead picker on /itineraries/new still uses the Combobox primitive directly rather than the shared RelationCombobox wrapper (functionally equivalent: search, select, resolves label for prefilled value). phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput remain false — itinerary entities have no phone/address fields, and pricing inputs are plain number fields tied to bespoke markup/GST math rather than the CurrencyInput primitive; wiring that in is a deeper change to the builder's pricing model, left out of this pass. DELETE /itineraries/:id/share-link (revoke) already has UI on the detail page's Share tab. No auto-save draft on /new (only /edit has autosave).
showcaseScript: Open Itineraries and filter by destination
Build a multi-day itinerary from a lead
Generate a public share link and open the quotation preview
Send the itinerary to the customer
Create a new version and compare
